notes: Add days since last flight/charge to the upload note.
One night = one set of 12: C1+C2 (set A) or C3+C4 (set B). Sets do not mix on a night; series never mix on a board.
One pack per channel per run, in the order listed, for both sets; keep each log file.
DX8-1 carries C1 (set A) or C3 (set B); DX8-2 carries C2 or C4. CH1 = P1-P3, CH2 = P4-P6.
New packs charge alone until 2 clean storage nights, then join their own series board under Rule B.
Rule B: rest V spread across a board <=0.30 V GO, 0.30-0.60 V CAUTION (reduced current), >0.60 V do not parallel.
IR from both DX8 chargers is validated against their screens.
